description.value: Family-owned riverside resort on the Eagle River in Sicamous, with tent sites set in open green spaces, a swimming pool, rental kayaks and paddleboards, and easy access to Shuswap and Mara Lakes. More full-service family resort than rustic camp — strong amenities but a heavy RV-park atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a family-owned campground in Sicamous operating since 1963, with tent sites, RV hookups, cabins, and yurts. The amenities page explicitly lists coin-operated showers and laundry (temporarily closed for repairs), a convenience store carrying ice and other supplies, and a swimming pool. Reservations are confirmed by the prominent booking form on every page. The about page mentions cycling trails in the area. OSM lacks a phone number but the website consistently lists 250-836-2583. The contact page has a typo ('Sicamouse' instead of 'Sicamous') but the address otherwise matches OSM.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website consistently lists 250-836-2583
Website contact page spells the city as 'Sicamouse' instead of 'Sicamous'
Showers and laundry are noted as temporarily closed for repairs on the amenities page
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground in Sicamous with tent sites, on-site amenities, and a riverside location along a cycling-friendly corridor between Mara and Shuswap Lakes. A good fit for touring cyclists in the Shuswap region.

wow_evidence: family-owned campground in Sicamous operating since 1963... coin-operated showers and laundry... swimming pool
